stories.title: Man to be sentenced after abandoning baby to die in Muncie motel room
stories.summary: Isabelle Vera was found dead in a baby swing by her mother after the child's father abandoned her and her 16-month-old sibling in 2023.

stories.title: Man sentenced after being involved in 'organized fraud scheme' targeting older adults in Carmel, Westfield
stories.summary: On Oct. 27, 2026, Ahmed Maqbul Syed, 60, was sentenced to 96 months in prison for conspiracy to commit money laundering.

stories.title: Greencastle police K-9 to receive body armor donation from national nonprofit
stories.summary: The body armor is U.S.-made, custom fitted and certified by the Nation Institute of Justice, according to the nonprofit Vested Interest in K9s.

stories.title: Old Bethel Food Pantry expanding operations with new community hub in January 2027
stories.summary: The food pantry currently serves around 1,500 shoppers every week, which is double what they used to serve in 2019, officials said.

stories.title: Jingle Rails returns to Eiteljorg Museum Nov. 21 with refreshed layout
stories.summary: The popular holiday model railroad, in its 17th year, will run through Jan. 18 and is included with regular museum admission.

stories.title: Here's where to find shelter during the winter months in Marion County
stories.summary: The Office of Public Health and Safety just announced its 2026 Winter Contingency plans to keep people safe and warm across Marion County.

stories.title: Indiana legislative leaders plan latest start for session in many years
stories.summary: The 50-member Senate will have 13 new senators — seven Democrats and six Republicans — along with 14 new committee chairs following Democratic gains.

stories.title: 1 dead, 2 injured after multi-vehicle crash on I-65 in Jasper County, semi driver allegedly refuses chemical test, another driver flees scene
stories.summary: According to a news release from Indiana State Police, troopers responded to a multi-vehicle crash on southbound I-65 in Jasper County around 8 p.m. Nov. 14.

stories.title: Irvington schools to resume classes Monday after fallout over financial cuts, teacher call-offs
stories.summary: The announcement of the schools' re-openings comes less than 24 hours after the Mayor's Office of Education Innovation threatened to revoke the district's charters.

stories.title: Terre Haute man found with several guns after allegedly threatening IMPD detective, 2 Indianapolis families
stories.summary: In addition to seizing a "large number" of firearms during a search warrant, the sheriff's office said deputies also found narcotics in the suspect's home.

stories.title: Memorial bike ride honors Indianapolis traffic crash victims
stories.summary: The group Central Indiana Cycling organized the memorial to honor those killed in traffic incidents and give their families an opportunity to share their stories.

stories.title: Pat Sullivan shares tips on how to be a good host this holiday season
stories.summary: Pat Sullivan with Sullivan Hardware and Garden is back and this week he's sharing tips on how to prepare for having company over this holiday season.
